headline: Frankie, you're waking up to two briefs at once — this morning's AM shipped 12.5 hours late, so it lands next to this one. And it got the day's biggest fact wrong: it said the cofounder sweep 'skipped its slot entirely,' but the scheduler shows the sweep fired at 13:36Z — five minutes after the AM looked — and still wrote nothing to your Mac. That is not a fourth outage; it is the same cloud-bridge wall meeting-ingest named at midnight. The sweep, the ingest, and the watchdog are one structural gap, and the fix is to rebuild them as LOCAL tasks — not to reload API credits again. Nothing else moved in the six hours since: the ads are still blind four days on 0/7 compliance, EIN is 59 days silent, and the booking funnel still hasn't seen a real lead. The infra is the whole story today; the rest is waiting on the two of you.

spotlight.title: The sweep fired at 13:36Z and still wrote nothing — the cloud-bridge is ONE shared root cause, not three outages
spotlight.detail: This is the correction that reframes the whole day. The AM read the scheduler at 13:31Z, saw the cofounder sweep hadn't fired, and called it 'skipped its slot entirely, next attempt tomorrow.' The scheduler now shows it fired five minutes later, at 13:36:57Z — and cofounder_log.json is still stamped Aug 25 17:33Z, so it produced no artifact. That is the exact failure meeting-ingest self-diagnosed at 00:02Z: it runs in an Anthropic cloud container with no bridge to your Mac, so 'Oraya HQ Reborn/daily-brief' is unreachable and every run fails identically. So the sweep, meeting-ingest, and the FA-ADS watchdog are not three separate outages competing for a credit reload — they are one structural gap. This very brief is the proof the fix is narrow: this session read and wrote that same folder all afternoon without a hitch, so the bridge exists for some tasks and not others. Rebuild the cofounder sweep AND meeting-ingest as LOCAL scheduled tasks — that is the master unblock, and it is not billing.
